title: Skyline Tower
description: A 40-story mixed-use development featuring premium office space and luxury retail. The tower's distinctive glass facade has become a landmark in the city's financial district.

title: The Morrison Estate
description: A stunning 8,000 sq ft custom home featuring modern architecture with natural materials. The estate includes a guest house, infinity pool, and landscaped gardens.

title: Heritage Loft Conversion
description: A century-old warehouse transformed into luxury loft apartments while preserving original brick walls and timber beams. Modern amenities seamlessly integrated with historic charm.

title: Central Distribution Hub
description: A 500,000 sq ft state-of-the-art distribution center with automated sorting systems and sustainable energy solutions.

title: Riverside Medical Center
description: A modern 6-story medical facility with specialized treatment centers, surgical suites, and patient care units designed for comfort and efficiency.

title: Oakwood Family Home
description: A warm and inviting 4,500 sq ft family home with open-plan living, chef's kitchen, and outdoor entertainment areas.
